visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed photographic slides with a light content card overlaid at the lower area of each slide. Dot indicators centered at the bottom and prev/next circular navigation controls. Rotating multi-slide banner.
contentPattern: One row per slide. First cell is the slide background image; second cell is the slide content (heading, description, single CTA link).
usage: Hero-style rotating banner at the top of a page with per-slide image, text, and call-to-action.
